reason: I'll install it because I install everything, but my use is opening a relative's phone photo and printing it, and Explorer plus whatever opens already does that. I don't have a speed problem, so there's nothing for it to fix.
why_switch_or_not: The speed numbers are impressive but I never open 5 pictures in a row at 2560x1440, I open one photo and print it. The list of RAW, PSD, 3D, video, archives, editor, importer and gallery is exactly the 'does too much' thing; I only want a viewer. I'd also need to see that printing works, and that HEIC from relatives' phones opens without me having to install Microsoft's HEVC extension first.
current_app_pros: Explorer thumbnails are already there, need no setup, and double-click opens the photo in whatever Windows picks. I don't have to maintain anything.
current_app_pains: Nothing much. It's a bit slow to open sometimes and I don't control which app grabs the file, but it doesn't bother me enough to go fix it.
objection: It does too much for one developer and one version number. A gallery, editor, importer and Explorer preview all in one means more surface to break, and I only need to open a picture and print it.
would_change_my_mind: A viewer-only mode with the gallery, editor, importer and preview agent switched off by default, plus clear one-click printing and phone-photo (HEIC) support that works out of the box.
